input.summary: Add express performance/conformance warranty with repair-replace-refund remedy and carve it out of the AS IS disclaimer.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Licensed Technology is currently provided wholly "AS IS" with all express and implied warranties disclaimed, so we have no conformance warranty or remedy; our playbook requires an express warranty that the software conforms to its Documentation for twelve (12) months (services performed in a professional and workmanlike manner for ninety (90) days), backed by repair, replacement or refund, plus compliance with law and no malicious code. We have added that warranty and carved it out of the disclaimer; we can discuss a shorter ninety (90) day software / thirty (30) day services period as a fallback.
